name: Topology-Caching for Dynamic Particle Volume Raycasting
aliases: GPU-based volume raycasting for particle systems
definition: A volume rendering technique for interactive visualization of dynamic particle systems (e.g., SPH) that uses three GPU-managed caches (node, influence, slab) to efficiently gather particle contributions for scalar field reconstruction via raycasting.
summary: Topology-Caching is a GPU-based volume rendering technique that enables interactive visualization of dynamic particle systems by using three GPU-managed caches to accelerate field reconstruction without preprocessing.
